folder.path.label: Project folder
folder.path.placeholder: Folder path on the server computer
folder.path.help: This is a folder on the computer where the server runs. Paste the path.
folder.pick.empty: The folder you choose appears here
folder.pick.waiting: Choose a folder in the folder dialog…
folder.pick.waiting_hint: If you don't see the dialog, check the taskbar or behind this browser window.
folder.pick.unavailable: This computer can't show a folder dialog, so browsing in the app opens instead.
folder.pick.failed: Couldn't open the folder dialog. Browsing in the app opens instead.
folder.pick.busy: Another folder dialog is already open. Choose a folder there or close it, then try again.
folder.pick.timeout: The dialog was closed because the selection timed out.
folder.browse.hint: The current location goes into the input.
folder.browse.truncated: Only the first {n} items are shown. Enter the path directly to narrow it down.
folder.browse.truncatedOne: Only the first {n} item is shown. Enter the path directly to narrow it down.
folder.browse.link: Link — saved as the real path
folder.browse.remote_disabled: The server accepts connections from outside this computer, so folder browsing isn't available. Enter the path directly.
folder.new.error.invalid: The folder name has characters that aren't allowed
folder.check.saved_as_diff: The path you entered is saved as {path}.
folder.check.readonly: You don't have write permission. Runs that write files in this folder may fail.
folder.check.readonly_config: Can't create a {dir} folder here, so you can't import or edit the configuration, and chats and runs can't be saved or started (viewing the configuration and logs still works). Fix the write permission to use them.
folder.check.creates_dir: A {dir} folder is created here to store the project configuration and memory. Other files in the folder aren't changed.
folder.check.creates_dir_unknown: A project config folder is created inside this folder to store the configuration and memory. Other files in the folder aren't changed.
folder.check.manifest_found: This folder already has a project configuration{detail}. It is loaded as it is.
folder.check.manifest_invalid: Can't read the project settings file in this folder. If you add it, the project starts in a “settings file error” state.
folder.check.missing: This folder doesn't exist. Create it?
folder.check.create: Create a folder at this path
folder.check.missing_parent: Can't create it because the parent folder doesn't exist. Choose an existing parent folder.
folder.check.not_directory: This is a file, not a folder. Choose a folder.
folder.check.no_access: Can't read this folder (permission). Choose a folder that the account running the server can access.
folder.check.taken: This folder is already registered as the project “{name}”.
folder.check.taken_archived: This folder was registered as “{name}” and then unregistered. You can continue with its earlier records.
folder.check.overlap_parent: The project “{name}” ({path}) already contains this folder.
folder.check.overlap_child: The project “{name}” ({path}) is already registered inside this folder. To register the parent folder, unregister that project first.
folder.check.overlap_why: Overlapping folders can't be registered separately, because a path that belongs to two projects mixes their logs and run records.
folder.check.remote_disabled: The server accepts connections from outside this computer, so the folder can't be checked. If you add it without checking the path, the server may reject it.
folder.check.same_path: This is the same as the previous path. If the folder exists again, select [Check again].
folder.check.nearest_note: The path you entered doesn't exist, so browsing starts at the nearest parent folder ({path}).
folder.check.invalid.foreign_path: This path format can't be used on this server.
folder.check.invalid.no_home: Can't expand ~ because the home folder is unknown.
folder.check.invalid.outside_roots: This path is outside the locations the server allows.
folder.check.invalid.invalid_path: The path has characters that aren't allowed.
